officialRule: AutoFX typically adjusts the otherwise applicable rate by 0.03%; no separate commission is charged.
implementationInference: An effective executed AutoFX price already incorporates its rate adjustment. The calculator must not apply another 0.03% to an explicitly entered actual execution price. A reference-market estimate still needs the published adjustment and remains an estimate.
scope: Live mainland-to-Hong-Kong calculator; the low-level brokerFx helper retains the market-rate default unless an inclusive execution price is explicitly indicated.
doesNotResolve: Current IBKR HKD/USD or CNH/USD execution price
IBKR internal USD-to-HKD local withdrawal implementation
